My name is Karen Rowe, and I am writing to formally apply for a personal loan. I can be reached at my residence, 52365 Maxwell Ranch Suite 543, Campbellfurt, Tennessee.

I am currently employed as Director of Operations at TechSolutions Inc., a position I was promoted to effective November 1, 2024. In this role, I oversee multiple departments and strategic initiatives, and I directly report to the Vice President of Operations. My current annual salary is $130,000, and I will also receive a $15,000 performance bonus. My employment terms were recently formalized through a revised employment contract, which reflects my long-term stability with the company.

I am a homeowner, and my financial obligations are well managed. My monthly mortgage payment is $1,350, and I maintain a consistent budget that comfortably accommodates my expenses. The purpose of this personal loan is to fund a planned home improvement project—specifically, a kitchen remodel estimated at $8,000—which will further enhance the value of my property.

Given my stable income, employment history, and strong financial management, I am confident in my ability to repay the loan in a timely manner. I would be happy to provide any additional documentation you may require, including proof of income, employment verification, or details regarding my financial obligations.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing the available loan options and terms at your earliest convenience.

Sincerely,
Karen Rowe
Director of Operations, TechSolutions Inc.
